# Naswa Wilantama — Fullstack Developer

> Portfolio of Naswa Wilantama (also known as Endabelyu), a fullstack developer based in Indonesia and available for remote work worldwide. 3 years of professional experience building production web apps with React, TypeScript, Hono, and PostgreSQL. Open to freelance projects and the right full-time role.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.endabelyu.com/): Role, skills, experience, and contact
- [All projects](https://www.endabelyu.com/projects): Full project archive, filterable by type

## Selected projects

- [Mili](https://www.endabelyu.com/projects/mili): Full-stack personal finance platform (React Router v7, Hono, Drizzle, Better Auth). Source: https://github.com/Endabelyu/mili and API https://github.com/Endabelyu/api-mili
- [Eisenhower Matrix](https://www.endabelyu.com/projects/eisenhower-matrix): Productivity app with Supabase (React, Vite). Source: https://github.com/Endabelyu/eisenhower-task-management
- [Bunga Nona](https://www.endabelyu.com/projects/bunga-nona): Florist catalog site on Cloudflare Workers (React Router v7)
- [Order Lens Management](https://www.endabelyu.com/projects/order-lens): Optical-shop order management system (React Router, Hono, PostgreSQL)
- [iropin Member Management](https://www.endabelyu.com/projects/iropin): Org membership system on Cloudflare Workers (Hono, PostgreSQL, Prisma)
